Projects.title: Quanta
desc: Quanta is a self-hosted AI agent for the Indonesian Stock Exchange (IDX) that monitors a personal portfolio, scans macro and Indonesian news five times a day, discovers undervalued stocks, and pushes color-coded alerts to Discord — all running on a private VPS with no auto-trading.

Under the hood, the agent runs a four-phase pipeline: Phase 0 gathers portfolio, budget, 13 RSS feeds, foreign flow, and macro indicators; Phase 1 uses Gemini 3 Flash to scout 10–15 candidates; Phase 2 fetches PBV, PER, RSI, SMA-200, and OBV; Phase 3 hands off to Gemini 3.1 Pro for deep analysis and DCA-first reasoning across three time horizons.

The dashboard surfaces a Strategic Intelligence feed with confidence-scored recommendations and full undervalued-stock breakdowns. A built-in chat panel lets the user ask questions like 'Should I DCA BBRI?' with live data fetched via AI tool calling — six tools spanning quotes, technicals, macro, portfolio, and recommendation history. Each recommendation is auto-scored at 7, 14, and 30 days for closed-loop performance feedback.

Projects.title: Invervyou AI
desc: Intervyou is an AI-driven SaaS platform designed to bridge the gap between education and employment by providing realistic interview simulations. The platform features a Gen AI engine that analyzes user responses and CVs to provide hyper-personalized feedback and material recommendations.

Built to scale, the system incorporates a gesture analysis module and a secure token-based payment gateway integrated with Midtrans. It currently serves over 3,000 users and is supported by Google for Startups and NVIDIA Inception.

Projects.title: Exacta Laboratory
desc: A comprehensive corporate landing page developed for PT Kalibrasi Surabaya (Exacta Laboratory) to establish a high-authority digital presence for their calibration and testing services. The platform serves as the primary communication hub between the laboratory and industrial clients across East Java.

The project focuses on high-performance web vitals and SEO optimization, ensuring that specialized technical services are easily discoverable and accessible. It features a modern, responsive design with clear service categorization and optimized lead generation funnels to streamline client inquiries.

Engineered with a focus on brand consistency and professional aesthetics, the platform utilizes advanced frontend techniques to provide a seamless user experience that reflects the laboratory's precision and technical excellence.

Projects.title: Client Personal Protfolio Website
desc: A personal portfolio website that I created for a client. The website is built using two main tech, native (HTML, CSSS, JS) and react based (ReactJs, TailwindCSS, Typescript). The website also created based on the client design, and improved and sliced by me. The website has a few features such as a about page, a project page, resume page, and a contact page.

The website is created using a modern design and a clean interface that appeals to a wide audience. The website also has a responsive design that makes it easy to use on any device. The website also has a few animations that make the website more interactive and engaging.

Projects.title: Mind Mirror
desc: LMS website that integrated Generative AI feauture to track studnet various keys like mood, behavior, and cognitive ability when learning. The website is built using Laravel as a fullstack framework. In this website teacher can track student mood and other metrics data based on the material students accessed.

The website also has a few features such as a dashboard for the teacher to see the student's data, a material page, and a quiz page. The website also has a few charts to visualize the student's data. The website provided the student captured data that can be downloaded by the teacher.
The website also has a features to export the lecture data such as the mood, behaviour, and cognitive score to a xlxs file that can be downloaded by the teacher.

Projects.title: Javanese Translation Website
desc: A Javanese ngoko - krama translation website that I created as a collaborative project with my friends. The website is built using the original Transformer architecture by Vaswani et al. (2017). Built with Python, TensorFlow, Flask, HTML, and CSS, the website allows users to input text in Javanese krama and receive the corresponding ngoko translation.

The website is designed to be simple to use, with a clean and modern interface that appeals to a wide audience. Users can input text in Javanese krama and receive the corresponding ngoko translation. The Project also provide ipynb file for the model training and the model itself.

Projects.title: Generative Trivia
desc: A generative trivia website built with Next.js, Firebase, NextAuth, Google OAuth, and TypeScript. Users can generate trivia questions for predefined school subjects and answer them with a unique interactive input style. The application supports user authentication with Google and stores data in Firestore.

The project is a culmination of my passion for web development and my desire to create a fun and interactive learning platform. The website is designed to be user-friendly and engaging, with a clean and modern interface that appeals to a wide audience. The trivia questions are generated using the Gemini API, which provides a diverse range of questions for users to answer.
